public_rationale: Later evidence shows claimed improvements and continuing uneven performance. Neither establishes how hard several original glitches were to fix. The available records do not connect specific failure classes to documented substantial remediation attempts, and the benchmark audit identifies important measurement confounds. With no deadline and no decisive event meeting the rule, the forecast remains unresolved.
limitations: Public development disclosures provide little detail about targeted repair effort.
Persistence alone cannot establish the proposed causal explanation.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Many of Sora's physics glitches will be hard to fix.

statement.excerpt: And importantly, I predict that many will be hard to remedy.

our_interpretation: Many refers to several of the physics and continuity failure classes discussed in the post.
Hard to remedy means requiring substantial remediation effort, rather than merely remaining visible at a later date.
Assess later Sora revisions, without treating results from unrelated video models as decisive.
The adjacent explanation about compression and data is not independently established by persistence of errors.
criteria.support_condition: Development records or repeated controlled evaluations show several original failure classes persisting despite substantial targeted remediation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Documented development and evaluation show that most relevant failure classes were reliably removed with straightforward fixes.
